_comment: Copy to raythink.config.json (gitignored). Shared settings applied to every Raythink camera; the config profile (LAN/Cellular) and the static-IP octet are chosen in the UI per camera (no manifest).
_comment_pw: Factory login is admin/admin; the tool changes it to new_password. A re-run of a half-configured camera falls back to new_password automatically.

static._comment: The camera moves to subnet_prefix.<octet> as the LAST step (the connection drops; the tool reconnects on the new address and renews the laptop's DHCP lease). octet is chosen in the UI: 'manual' = type it, 'cycle' = auto 30 -> 31 -> ... -> 50 -> 30. default_mode sets which the UI opens on.

_comment_profiles: Each profile is a config JSON exported from a reference camera (Setup > System > Export). Import replays each config table via setConfig. Real profiles/*.json are gitignored; commit only the *.example.json templates. Keep the device's Network/IP table OUT of these files — the tool sets the static IP and NTP itself, after the import.
_comment_timeouts: import_reboot_timeout: seconds to wait for the camera to come back if a config import reboots it. ip_move_timeout: seconds to wait for the camera to answer on its new static IP.
